features.dominant_unit: Hesperian and Noachian highland undivided unit

mapped_units.name: Hesperian and Noachian highland undivided unit

source.dataset: USGS SIM 3292 Global Geologic Map of Mars (Tanaka et al., 2014)

methods.area: USGS Mars geological polygons transformed to the site metric CRS; clipped to the footprint; area fraction computed
methods.caveat: Global geology cannot resolve crater ejecta, exposed strata, and small-scale lithologic variations at 5km scale. Do not equate global USGS codes with detailed local Victoria Crater geological units.
